business_problem: Luminator's field technicians and service teams were relying on spreadsheets, PDFs, emails, and manual triage to troubleshoot transit equipment, answer case-status questions, and keep customers informed across a growing support queue.
solution_summary: Luminator is using Agentforce across technician support, customer service, and proactive sales by grounding the agent in data from Agentforce Service, Agentforce Manufacturing, and Experience Cloud. Technicians access the agent from phones or tablets, where Agentforce reasons over structured records such as serial numbers and unstructured artifacts such as past chats, emails, and troubleshooting documents to explain error messages and suggest repair steps. When the issue is unusual, Agentforce compares the job with similar historical cases, proposes likely fixes, and then writes the completed repair summary back into the customer's service profile instead of forcing manual note taking. The same architecture powers 24/7 customer status updates and sales prep, letting customers check parts, warranties, and case progress in chat while internal teams use the unified account and asset history to anticipate renewal or warranty opportunities.
data_flow: Technicians and customers log into Luminator's Experience Cloud site, ask Agentforce about a product or case, and the agent pulls serial-number records, prior chats, emails, and asset history from Agentforce Service and Agentforce Manufacturing before returning guidance, summaries, or part-status updates.
business_outcome: Luminator expects technicians to solve issues faster, customers to get 24/7 repair transparency, and service teams to become more efficient while also surfacing warranty and replacement-part sales opportunities from the same data foundation.
